column3: The placement of among the lions and among the young lions is rearranged.
“In vain” specifies the waiting; “another” renders one.
Breaking down strongholds replaces knowing his widows; shuddering replaces becoming desolate.
“In your vineyard” replaces in your blood.
“Fit for” supplies the suitability of branches for scepters.
The rod consumed by fire is singular in Hebrew; “them” retains the preceding plural.
“Main branch” renders a rod of its branches; “shall be used” expresses the closing becoming a lament.
